image.name: dolphin
image.description: [Dolphin Emulator](https://dolphin-emu.org/) lets you play GameCube and Wii games with various graphical enhancements and other features are available to improve your game experience.

changelog.desc: Build dolphin from source, ingest latest versions, remove aarch64 support.
Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Rebase to Debian Trixie for updated Dolphin, update controller mapping.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores local files and settings

ports.desc: Dolphin desktop gui HTTP must be proxied.

image.title: Dolphin
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

**On container creation you need to exit and open dolphin in order for gamepads to work. Right click the desktop to open programs.**

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  dolphin:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/dolphin:latest
    container_name: dolphin
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=dolphin \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/dolphin:latest
